AI providers

Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools. Transcription works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).

No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).

🔒 Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are only sent to the provider you pick.

Captions on this PC

Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.

Bengali.AI Whisper medium · Bangla only

539 MB download · about 15 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.3 GB of memory

Bangla only: used whenever the spoken language is Bengali, never for other languages. Far fewer mistakes in Bangla than the other models.

Bengali.AI Whisper medium (Apache-2.0 licence) by Bengali.AI (the tugstugi team), fine-tuned from OpenAI Whisper; converted to ggml by WinShades · huggingface.co/winshades/bengaliai-whisper-medium-ggml (11cf5cb)

    - heading "AI providers" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools.
      - strong: Transcription
      - text: works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).
    - paragraph: No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).

    - strong: On this PC
    - text: no key · good for drafts

    - paragraph: No provider yet. Add one to transcribe recordings and work on captions.
    - button "+ Add provider"

      - option "US$0.10"
      - option "US$1" [selected]
      - option "US$5"
      - option "Never"

    - heading "Captions on this PC" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.
    - radiogroup "Model used for new captions":
      - radio "Whisper tiny · Fast" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper tiny · Fast
      - paragraph: 44 MB download · under 1 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 340 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Quickest; for slower PCs. Less accurate with accents and noise.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper tiny, 44 megabytes": Download 44 MB
      - radio "Whisper base · Standard" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper base · Standard
      - text: Recommended
      - paragraph: 60 MB download · about 1½ min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 399 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Recommended for most recordings.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper base, 60 megabytes": Download 60 MB
      - radio "Whisper small · Accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper small · Accurate
      - paragraph: 190 MB download · about 5 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 626 MB of memory
      - paragraph: More accurate, also for other languages; about 3.7 times slower than Standard.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper small, 190 megabytes": Download 190 MB

      - paragraph: 574 MB download · about 19 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.1 GB of memory
      - paragraph: Most accurate, but slower than real time on most PCs.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper large-v3 turbo, 574 megabytes": Download 574 MB

      - button "Download Bengali.AI Whisper medium, 539 megabytes": Download 539 MB

Settings
AI providers

Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools. Transcription works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).

No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).

🔒 Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are only sent to the provider you pick.

Captions on this PC

Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.

Whisper tiny · Fast

44 MB download · under 1 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 340 MB of memory

Quickest; for slower PCs. Less accurate with accents and noise.

Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)

Download 44 MB
Whisper base · Standard
Recommended

60 MB download · about 1½ min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 399 MB of memory

Recommended for most recordings.

Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)

Download 60 MB
Whisper small · Accurate

190 MB download · about 5 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 626 MB of memory

More accurate, also for other languages; about 3.7 times slower than Standard.

Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)

Download 190 MB
Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate

574 MB download · about 19 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.1 GB of memory

Most accurate, but slower than real time on most PCs.

Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)

Download 574 MB
Bengali.AI Whisper medium · Bangla only

539 MB download · about 15 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.3 GB of memory

Bangla only: used whenever the spoken language is Bengali, never for other languages. Far fewer mistakes in Bangla than the other models.

Bengali.AI Whisper medium (Apache-2.0 licence) by Bengali.AI (the tugstugi team), fine-tuned from OpenAI Whisper; converted to ggml by WinShades · huggingface.co/winshades/bengaliai-whisper-medium-ggml (11cf5cb)

Download 539 MB

Speech engine: ready

Speech detector: built in (Silero VAD). Remove silences, Smart speed, music ducking and the camera director listen for speech, so typing and fans do not count as sound.

screens.aria:
- banner:
  - img "Flown"
  - button "Settings" [expanded]
- main:
  - region "What to record":
    - heading "What to record" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Pick the screen to record.
    - button "Screens"
    - button "Windows"
    - button "Area"
    - button "Refresh sources"
    - button "Entire screen" [pressed]
  - region "Recent recordings":
    - heading "Recent recordings 2" [level=2]
    - button "Import video"
    - 'combobox "Search recordings: words said, titles, chapters and notes"'
    - status
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "0:04 Phone demo Yesterday, 04:45 PM"
        - button "Show Phone demo in Explorer"
        - button "Delete Phone demo"
      - listitem:
        - button "0:06 Product tour Mar 10, 2026"
        - button "Show Product tour in Explorer"
        - button "Delete Product tour"
  - complementary:
    - heading "New recording" [level=2]
    - text: Entire screen
    - group "Audio and camera":
      - text: Microphone
      - combobox "Microphone":
        - option "No microphone" [selected]
      - text: Camera
      - combobox "Camera":
        - option "No camera" [selected]
      - text: System audio
      - checkbox "System audio" [disabled]
      - text: Record keyboard activity
      - checkbox "Record keyboard activity" [checked]
      - paragraph: Shortcuts and when you type, never which keys.
      - text: Frame rate
      - group "Frame rate":
        - button "30 fps"
        - button "60 fps" [pressed]
    - group "Speaker notes":
      - text: Speaker notes
      - paragraph: "Add a script or bullet points to read while you record. Only you see them: they stay out of the video."
      - button "Add notes…"
    - text: Preset
    - combobox "Recording preset" [disabled]:
      - option "No presets saved" [disabled] [selected]
    - button "Save as preset"
    - button "Delete preset" [disabled]
    - button "More options Countdown, auto-pause, hotkeys"
    - button "Start recording"
    - paragraph: Stop with the floating bar or Ctrl Shift 2 .
- dialog "Settings":
  - banner:
    - heading "Settings" [level=2]
    - button "Close settings"
  - region "AI providers":
    - heading "AI providers" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools.
      - strong: Transcription
      - text: works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).
    - paragraph: No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).
    - paragraph: Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are only sent to the provider you pick.
    - strong: On this PC
    - text: no key · good for drafts
    - button "Set up AI on this PC": Set up
    - paragraph: No provider yet. Add one to transcribe recordings and work on captions.
    - button "+ Add provider"
    - text: Ask before a run that costs more than
    - combobox "Ask before a run that costs more than":
      - option "Always ask"
      - option "US$0.10"
      - option "US$1" [selected]
      - option "US$5"
      - option "Never"
  - region "Captions on this PC":
    - heading "Captions on this PC" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.
    - radiogroup "Model used for new captions":
      - radio "Whisper tiny · Fast" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper tiny · Fast
      - paragraph: 44 MB download · under 1 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 340 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Quickest; for slower PCs. Less accurate with accents and noise.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper tiny, 44 megabytes": Download 44 MB
      - radio "Whisper base · Standard" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper base · Standard
      - text: Recommended
      - paragraph: 60 MB download · about 1½ min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 399 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Recommended for most recordings.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper base, 60 megabytes": Download 60 MB
      - radio "Whisper small · Accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper small · Accurate
      - paragraph: 190 MB download · about 5 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 626 MB of memory
      - paragraph: More accurate, also for other languages; about 3.7 times slower than Standard.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper small, 190 megabytes": Download 190 MB
      - radio "Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate
      - paragraph: 574 MB download · about 19 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.1 GB of memory
      - paragraph: Most accurate, but slower than real time on most PCs.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper large-v3 turbo, 574 megabytes": Download 574 MB

Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools. Transcription works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).

No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).

  - img "Flown"
  - button "Settings" [expanded]

    - button "Screens"
    - button "Windows"
    - button "Area"

    - button "Entire screen" [pressed]
  - region "Recent recordings":
    - heading "Recent recordings 2" [level=2]
    - button "Import video"

    - status
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - button "0:04 Phone demo Yesterday, 04:45 PM"

        - button "Delete Phone demo"
      - listitem:
        - button "0:06 Product tour Mar 10, 2026"
        - button "Show Product tour in Explorer"
        - button "Delete Product tour"
  - complementary:
    - heading "New recording" [level=2]
    - text: Entire screen
    - group "Audio and camera":
      - text: Microphone
      - combobox "Microphone":
        - option "No microphone" [selected]
      - text: Camera
      - combobox "Camera":
        - option "No camera" [selected]
      - text: System audio
      - checkbox "System audio" [disabled]
      - text: Record keyboard activity
      - checkbox "Record keyboard activity" [checked]
      - paragraph: Shortcuts and when you type, never which keys.
      - text: Frame rate
      - group "Frame rate":
        - button "30 fps"
        - button "60 fps" [pressed]
    - group "Speaker notes":
      - text: Speaker notes
      - paragraph: "Add a script or bullet points to read while you record. Only you see them: they stay out of the video."
      - button "Add notes…"
    - text: Preset
    - combobox "Recording preset" [disabled]:
      - option "No presets saved" [disabled] [selected]
    - button "Save as preset"
    - button "Delete preset" [disabled]
    - button "More options Countdown, auto-pause, hotkeys"
    - button "Start recording"
    - paragraph: Stop with the floating bar or Ctrl Shift 2 .
- dialog "Settings":
  - banner:
    - heading "Settings" [level=2]
    - button "Close settings"
  - region "AI providers":
    - heading "AI providers" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools.
      - strong: Transcription
      - text: works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).
    - paragraph: No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).
    - paragraph: Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are only sent to the provider you pick.
    - strong: On this PC
    - text: no key · good for drafts
    - button "Set up AI on this PC": Set up
    - paragraph: No provider yet. Add one to transcribe recordings and work on captions.
    - button "+ Add provider"
    - text: Ask before a run that costs more than
    - combobox "Ask before a run that costs more than":
      - option "Always ask"
      - option "US$0.10"
      - option "US$1" [selected]
      - option "US$5"
      - option "Never"
  - region "Captions on this PC":
    - heading "Captions on this PC" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.
    - radiogroup "Model used for new captions":
      - radio "Whisper tiny · Fast" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper tiny · Fast
      - paragraph: 44 MB download · under 1 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 340 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Quickest; for slower PCs. Less accurate with accents and noise.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper tiny, 44 megabytes": Download 44 MB
      - radio "Whisper base · Standard" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper base · Standard
      - text: Recommended
      - paragraph: 60 MB download · about 1½ min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 399 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Recommended for most recordings.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper base, 60 megabytes": Download 60 MB
      - radio "Whisper small · Accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper small · Accurate
      - paragraph: 190 MB download · about 5 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 626 MB of memory
      - paragraph: More accurate, also for other languages; about 3.7 times slower than Standard.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper small, 190 megabytes": Download 190 MB
      - radio "Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate
      - paragraph: 574 MB download · about 19 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.1 GB of memory
      - paragraph: Most accurate, but slower than real time on most PCs.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper large-v3 turbo, 574 megabytes": Download 574 MB
      - strong: Bengali.AI Whisper medium · Bangla only
      - paragraph: 539 MB download · about 15 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.3 GB of memory
      - paragraph: "Bangla only: used whenever the spoken language is Bengali, never for other languages. Far fewer mistakes in Bangla than the other models."
      - paragraph: Bengali.AI Whisper medium (Apache-2.0 licence) by Bengali.AI (the tugstugi team), fine-tuned from OpenAI Whisper; converted to ggml by WinShades · huggingface.co/winshades/bengaliai-whisper-medium-ggml (11cf5cb)
      - button "Download Bengali.AI Whisper medium, 539 megabytes": Download 539 MB
    - paragraph: "Speech engine: ready"
    - paragraph: "Speech detector: built in (Silero VAD). Remove silences, Smart speed, music ducking and the camera director listen for speech, so typing and fans do not count as sound."
    - text: Speech models use 0 MB · ‹masked› free on this drive
    - button "Show folder"
  - region "AI on this PC":
    - heading "AI on this PC" [level=3]
    - paragraph: "Writes titles, chapter names, summaries, clean-ups, translations and posts with no key, and sends nothing anywhere. Good for drafts: check what it writes. Slower than an AI service."
    - paragraph: AI on this PC is not part of this build.
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Recommended
      - text: · Gemma 4 E2B · 3.1 GB
    - paragraph: Every language, including Bangla. Needs 12 GB of memory.
    - paragraph: Apache-2.0 · Google
    - paragraph: AI on this PC is not part of this build.
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Small
      - text: · Qwen3.5 2B · 1.3 GB
    - paragraph: Rough drafts, for PCs with 8 GB of memory.
    - paragraph: Apache-2.0 · Alibaba Cloud
    - paragraph: AI on this PC is not part of this build.
    - status
  - region "Downloads for captions":
    - heading "Downloads for captions" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Nothing downloaded. Chinese, Japanese and Korean caption fonts download when you pick them in Captions › Look › Text.
  - region "Brand kit":
    - heading "Brand kit" [level=3]:
      - text: Brand kit
      - status
    - paragraph: Your logo, colours, fonts, intro and outro, saved once. Apply them to a video from the editor's Style tab.

    - button "Choose logo…"

    - list "Brand colours":
      - textbox "New colour": "#6252fc"
      - button "Add colour"
    - paragraph: The first colour fills the intro and outro cards; all of them show first in a title card's colour pickers.

    - text: Intro title card

    - heading "AI providers" [level=3]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Use your own API key for auto captions and transcript tools.
      - strong: Transcription
      - text: works with OpenAI or Google Gemini. All three providers can clean up and translate a transcript and suggest chapters, a title or a summary for it; Anthropic Claude cannot transcribe (the Claude API does not accept sound).
    - paragraph: No key? Captions can also be made on this PC, free and offline (see Captions on this PC below).
    - paragraph: Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are only sent to the provider you pick.
    - strong: On this PC
    - text: no key · good for drafts

    - paragraph: No provider yet. Add one to transcribe recordings and work on captions.
    - button "+ Add provider"

      - option "US$0.10"
      - option "US$1" [selected]
      - option "US$5"
      - option "Never"

    - heading "Captions on this PC" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Make captions without an API key. The speech model runs on this PC, so the sound never leaves it and nothing is billed. Each model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and checked before it is used.
    - radiogroup "Model used for new captions":
      - radio "Whisper tiny · Fast" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper tiny · Fast
      - paragraph: 44 MB download · under 1 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 340 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Quickest; for slower PCs. Less accurate with accents and noise.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper tiny, 44 megabytes": Download 44 MB
      - radio "Whisper base · Standard" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper base · Standard
      - text: Recommended
      - paragraph: 60 MB download · about 1½ min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 399 MB of memory
      - paragraph: Recommended for most recordings.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper base, 60 megabytes": Download 60 MB
      - radio "Whisper small · Accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper small · Accurate
      - paragraph: 190 MB download · about 5 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 626 MB of memory
      - paragraph: More accurate, also for other languages; about 3.7 times slower than Standard.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper small, 190 megabytes": Download 190 MB
      - radio "Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate" [disabled]
      - strong: Whisper large-v3 turbo · Most accurate
      - paragraph: 574 MB download · about 19 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.1 GB of memory
      - paragraph: Most accurate, but slower than real time on most PCs.
      - paragraph: Whisper by OpenAI (MIT licence), converted by the whisper.cpp project · huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp (5359861)
      - button "Download Whisper large-v3 turbo, 574 megabytes": Download 574 MB
      - strong: Bengali.AI Whisper medium · Bangla only
      - paragraph: 539 MB download · about 15 min per 10 minutes of recording on this PC · about 1.3 GB of memory

      - paragraph: Bengali.AI Whisper medium (Apache-2.0 licence) by Bengali.AI (the tugstugi team), fine-tuned from OpenAI Whisper; converted to ggml by WinShades · huggingface.co/winshades/bengaliai-whisper-medium-ggml (11cf5cb)
      - button "Download Bengali.AI Whisper medium, 539 megabytes": Download 539 MB

attrs.title: Versions: save this edit, or go back to an earlier one (Ctrl + Shift + S)
Polish in one click: silences, zooms, captions, camera and style (Shift + P)
Write the text to post with the video
Make a step-by-step guide or a click-through demo from your clicks
Position / length of the exported video
Preview speed: play the preview faster or slower to review it (< slower, > faster). The exported video keeps its own speed.
Split the clip at the playhead (S)
Add a zoom at the playhead (Z)
Add a magnifier at the playhead
Zoom in a little closer on the field you type into, and stay there until you stop typing (short pauses included)
Zoom where you pressed the zoom-here shortcut while recording
Show the whole page while it scrolls, then zoom in where you stop
Keep the zoom steady until scrolling stops
Scrolling does not change the zooms
Snapping on: edges and the playhead snap to cuts, clicks, chapters and other items. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely (N)
Click to move the playhead, Shift+drag to select a range to cut · Waveform: the recording's sound; darker stretches are pauses
0:00.5 – 0:02.0 · 2× · edited zoom · Ctrl+click to select several
0:03.0 – 0:04.5 · 1.6× · automatic zoom · Ctrl+click to select several
Intro · 0:00.0 · drag to move · Ctrl+click to select several
Saving · 0:03.0 · drag to move · Ctrl+click to select several
Double-click to add a title card
Here is the product tour · 0:00.5 – 0:02.5 · double-click to edit the text
Now we save the file · 0:03.2 – 0:05.2 · double-click to edit the text
Double-click to change the camera layout here
Save this frame as a PNG at the export size
Copy the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) for the video's description
X (Twitter) takes videos up to 2:20 and 512 MB
4:5, for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn feeds
A large MOV that stays sharp in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects
Captions, texts and the camera on a see-through background, to lay over another video
H.264 video with AAC audio: plays everywhere
H.264 in a QuickTime movie, for Final Cut, Premiere and Keynote
VP9 video with Opus audio, for the web
An animated image that plays silently and loops (15 fps)
The soundtrack only (AAC), nothing is rendered
The soundtrack only, uncompressed (32-bit float WAV), nothing is rendered
GoPro CineForm, for editing in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects: large files that stay sharp through more editing. Can be transparent
QuickTime Animation: lossless and transparent, very large. For short overlays
The background as in the preview
No background: the recording, the camera and everything over them stay; around them the video is see-through
Only what goes over the recording: the camera, captions, texts, images, key presses, title cards and the progress bar. No recording and no background. For laying over another video
1920×1080; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
2560×1440; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
3840×2160; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
The project's own shape (Auto, Style panel)
Export in 16:9; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 9:16; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 1:1; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 4:3; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 4:5 (1080×1350 at 1080p); the project keeps its own shape
The film rate. Scrolling looks less smooth than at 30
The TV rate in Europe, Africa, South Asia and Australia
For 120 Hz screens. Most sites play at most 60 fps. Exports take about twice as long as 60 fps
Save the captions as an SRT file next to the video, one per language (YouTube, Vimeo, most players)
Save the captions as a WebVTT file next to the video, one per language (web players)
Save the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) in a text file
Save the frame chosen above as a PNG at the export size
Save a description with the title, length and chapters, ready to paste
One 32-bit float WAV file per sound, to mix in other software: voice, system sound, music and effects
A timeline for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with chapter markers
Export each chapter as its own file (01 Intro, 02 …) into a folder. Music starts again in each file.

Write the text to post with the video
Make a step-by-step guide or a click-through demo from your clicks
Position / length of the exported video
Preview speed: play the preview faster or slower to review it (< slower, > faster). The exported video keeps its own speed.
Split the clip at the playhead (S)
Add a zoom at the playhead (Z)
Add a magnifier at the playhead
Zoom in a little closer on the field you type into, and stay there until you stop typing (short pauses included)
Zoom where you pressed the zoom-here shortcut while recording
Show the whole page while it scrolls, then zoom in where you stop
Keep the zoom steady until scrolling stops
Scrolling does not change the zooms
Snapping on: edges and the playhead snap to cuts, clicks, chapters and other items. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely (N)

Save this frame as a PNG at the export size
Copy the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) for the video's description
X (Twitter) takes videos up to 2:20 and 512 MB
4:5, for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn feeds
A large MOV that stays sharp in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects
Captions, texts and the camera on a see-through background, to lay over another video
H.264 video with AAC audio: plays everywhere
H.264 in a QuickTime movie, for Final Cut, Premiere and Keynote
VP9 video with Opus audio, for the web
An animated image that plays silently and loops (15 fps)
The soundtrack only (AAC), nothing is rendered
The soundtrack only, uncompressed (32-bit float WAV), nothing is rendered
About half the size of H.264 at the same quality. Fast with a recent graphics card, slower without one. Plays in browsers, on YouTube and in Windows 11
The background as in the preview
No background: the recording, the camera and everything over them stay; around them the video is see-through
Only what goes over the recording: the camera, captions, texts, images, key presses, title cards and the progress bar. No recording and no background. For laying over another video
1920×1080; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
2560×1440; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
3840×2160; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
The project's own shape (Auto, Style panel)

Export in 9:16; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 1:1; the project keeps its own shape

Export in 4:5 (1080×1350 at 1080p); the project keeps its own shape
The film rate. Scrolling looks less smooth than at 30
The TV rate in Europe, Africa, South Asia and Australia
For 120 Hz screens. Most sites play at most 60 fps. Exports take about twice as long as 60 fps
Save the captions as an SRT file next to the video, one per language (YouTube, Vimeo, most players)
Save the captions as a WebVTT file next to the video, one per language (web players)
Save the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) in a text file
Save the frame chosen above as a PNG at the export size
Save a description with the title, length and chapters, ready to paste
One 32-bit float WAV file per sound, to mix in other software: voice, system sound, music and effects
A timeline for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with chapter markers
Export each chapter as its own file (01 Intro, 02 …) into a folder. Music starts again in each file.

attrs.title: Versions: save this edit, or go back to an earlier one (Ctrl + Shift + S)

Write the text to post with the video
Make a step-by-step guide or a click-through demo from your clicks
Position / length of the exported video
Preview speed: play the preview faster or slower to review it (< slower, > faster). The exported video keeps its own speed.
Split the clip at the playhead (S)
Add a zoom at the playhead (Z)
Add a magnifier at the playhead
Zoom in a little closer on the field you type into, and stay there until you stop typing (short pauses included)
Zoom where you pressed the zoom-here shortcut while recording
Show the whole page while it scrolls, then zoom in where you stop
Keep the zoom steady until scrolling stops
Scrolling does not change the zooms
Snapping on: edges and the playhead snap to cuts, clicks, chapters and other items. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely (N)
Click to move the playhead, Shift+drag to select a range to cut · Waveform: the recording's sound; darker stretches are pauses
0:00.5 – 0:02.0 · 2× · edited zoom · Ctrl+click to select several

Now we save the file · 0:03.2 – 0:05.2 · double-click to edit the text

Save this frame as a PNG at the export size
Copy the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) for the video's description
X (Twitter) takes videos up to 2:20 and 512 MB
4:5, for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn feeds
A large MOV that stays sharp in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve and After Effects
Captions, texts and the camera on a see-through background, to lay over another video
H.264 video with AAC audio: plays everywhere
H.264 in a QuickTime movie, for Final Cut, Premiere and Keynote
VP9 video with Opus audio, for the web
An animated image that plays silently and loops (15 fps)
The soundtrack only (AAC), nothing is rendered
The soundtrack only, uncompressed (32-bit float WAV), nothing is rendered
About half the size of H.264 at the same quality. Fast with a recent graphics card, slower without one. Plays in browsers, on YouTube and in Windows 11
1920×1080; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled
2560×1440; larger than the recording (1280×720): it will be upscaled

Export in 9:16; the project keeps its own shape
Export in 1:1; the project keeps its own shape

The TV rate in Europe, Africa, South Asia and Australia
For 120 Hz screens. Most sites play at most 60 fps. Exports take about twice as long as 60 fps

Save the captions as a WebVTT file next to the video, one per language (web players)
Save the chapters as YouTube timestamps (0:00 Intro…) in a text file
Save the frame chosen above as a PNG at the export size
Save a description with the title, length and chapters, ready to paste
One 32-bit float WAV file per sound, to mix in other software: voice, system sound, music and effects
A timeline for DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with chapter markers
Writes an FCPXML file. In Resolve: File › Import › Timeline…
Writes a Premiere XML file. In Premiere: File › Import…
Writes an FCPXML file for a Mac. Made on Windows: keep the files together and, on the Mac, use File › Relink Files…
A CMX 3600 EDL with the finished video, for editors that read EDL
Export each chapter as its own file (01 Intro, 02 …) into a folder. Music starts again in each file.

A solid shadow offset down and to the right
A see-through, frosted border instead of a solid colour
Set up your brand kit in Settings first
Snapping on: edges and the playhead snap to cuts, clicks, chapters and other items. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely (N)
Click to move the playhead, Shift+drag to select a range to cut
Double-click to add a title card
